name: @story/data
comment:devDependencies: `assets/index.ts` is built on `import.meta.glob` and carries its own `/// <reference types="vite/client" />`. That reference used to resolve only because the root app hoisted vite; now that the apps own their own configs, the package that needs the types declares them. `@story/canvas` is test-only: `test/maps.test.ts` asserts the polygon invariants using the same geometry the Visualizer normalises with (VISUALIZER_PLAN §4.2). The authored story must never import it — eslint enforces that split.
